newsitem.title: USA: Berg Electronics to build plant in Ireland.
newsitem.headline: Berg Electronics to build plant in Ireland.

text.p: Berg Electronics Corp said Monday it would invest more than $11.8 million to build a manufacturing facility in Fermoy, County Cork, Ireland.

The plant will make a variety of electronic connectors for use in the computer and telecommunications industries. St. Louis-based Berg said it would hire about 310 people during the next three years to work in the plant.
The Irish plant will be third European manufacturing facility for Berg, which makes electronic connectors, sockets and cable assembly products. The other facilities are in France and the Netherlands.
The company is being supported in its efforts by the Industrial Development Agency of Ireland, said Berg.
Berg shares added 3/8 to close at 29-1/4.
